'''Goontirk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] who owned the ''[[Madman's Fortune]]'', a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] exhibit [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that he flew as part of a traveling freak show. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, Goontirk purchased the mummified remains of [[Vardovin IV]], the "Lost [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]," from a [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]]. While Goontirk was uncertain as to whether the mummy was authentic, he believed that even if fake, the corpse would be an interesting curiosity for him to carry aboard the ''Madman's Fortune''. However, unknown to Goontirk, the mummy contained more than a dozen [[skekfish]] eggs and while the ''Madman's Fortune'' was passing through the [[Engebo system/Legends|Engebo system]], the mummy's [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]] coffin cracked open and the skekfish eggs hatched. The creatures attacked Goontirk and in an attempt to escape from them, he ran into one of the ship's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. The skekfish followed him in and they devoured the Goontirk before he could launch the pod, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Snivvian.
